Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are looking for a Product-Led Marketing & Digital Funnels Manager to own and scale customer acquisition through paid media, webinars, and product-driven marketing funnels for our K-12 solutions.


This role is responsible for building and optimizing full-funnel digital programs from ads to webinars to product demos that generate qualified pipeline and revenue. You will operate at the intersection of product marketing, demand generation, and digital growth, turning interest into engaged prospects and customers through high-performing funnel systems.


Responsibilities

  • Own paid ads strategy across , Google, and retargeting to drive qualified leads
  • Manage and scale webinar programs from promotion through follow-up and conversion
  • Build and optimize digital funnels from ad to landing page to demo or sales opportunity
  • Create and improve landing pages, email nurture sequences, and conversion paths
  • Track and optimize funnel performance including conversion rates, CPL, and pipeline generated
  • Run A/B tests and scale campaigns that consistently generate pipeline


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, demand generation, or funnel management, preferably in K-12, EdTech, or SaaS
  • Proven experience running paid ads, webinars, and digital funnel programs that generate pipeline
  • Strong understanding of product-led marketing and multi-touch buyer journeys
  • Experience with marketing and CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Ads, and Google Ads
  • Analytical and results-driven with a focus on conversion and revenue metrics
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.

  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT


About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.


Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.


Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.


Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.


Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician.
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and evolution of services and APIs that power our digital applications and products. This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.


A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment. The proof of concept will demonstrate deterministic orchestration, rule-based evaluation, integration with third-party APIs, and the generation of non-binding scenarios through an AI interface.

Fluent English is essential, as the role involves close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications
  • Validate end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in backend development
  • Proficiency in C#
  • Experience with SQL databases and relational database design
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. In this role, your responsibilities will be:

  • Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.

Who You Are:

You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.


For this role, you will need:

  • Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
  • 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments.
  • Availability to work overtime, as needed.

Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

Buscamos profissional para atuar na gestão funcional e governança do ecossistema SAP de RH, com foco em SAP SuccessFactors (lado cliente, sem acesso a provisioning), SAP HCM migrando para SAP S/4, garantindo sustentação, evolução e alinhamento estratégico das soluções.


Responsabilidades e Requisitos Técnicos:

1. Gestão Funcional do SuccessFactors


  • Atuar como ponto focal interno da TI da solução SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Administrar configurações funcionais permitidas no ambiente produtivo (sem acesso a provisioning – essa responsabilidade é da consultoria AMS).
  • Organizar e priorizar demandas evolutivas junto ao RH.
  • Especificar requisitos com foco em melhorias ou novas demandas para atendimento via consultoria externa.
  • Escrever especificações funcionais para desenvolvimentos específicos ou integrações.
  • Validar entregas e realizar testes funcionais (UAT).
  • Conhecer, monitorar e direcionar ações nas integrações com sistemas satélites.
  • Entender processo de negócio e solução técnica para direcionar ações evolutivas nos APPs Fiori desenvolvidos em SAP BTP de modo a gerenciar as entregas, melhorias e suporte dado pela consultoria responsável.
  • Diferencial ter conhecimento na navegação do BTP e IAS.
  • Diferencial ter conhecimento em SFSF EC.
  • Acompanhar roadmap, tendências e atualizações SAP.
  • Analisar release notes, atualizações de quarters, avaliar impactos no ambiente, abrir e acompanhar chamados no SAP for Me.
  • Entender e suportar as liberações de Acessos conforme papéis e responsabilidades da governança GP.
  • Módulos SFSF atualmente instalados: EP, LMS, Recruiting, Metas e Desempenho, Carreira e Sucessão.

2. Gestão de Sistemas Satélites


  • Melhorias, sustentação e governança com foco em:
  • Conhecimentos em SAP HCM em PA, OM, PY, BN, TM e eSocial.
  • Apoiar no SAP HCM (suporte Rimini)
  • Participar ativamente no projeto de migração do ECC para S/4Hana (em andamento).
  • Diferencial com conhecimentos no Ronda (controle de ponto), DMS (gestão documental).
  • Monitorar e direcionar de atendimento ao suporte de interfaces e integrações aos sistemas que compõe o landscape de soluções de RH
  • Atuar em chamados específicos e/ou em incidentes críticos.
  • Apoiar e suportar à obrigações legais dentro dos processos de RH, tais como: eSocial, admissões, afastamentos, atualização sindicais, desligamento, movimentações, LGPD, etc.
  • Apoiar demais sistemas integrados ao ecosistema de RH como: SOC, eBox, AD Azure, etc.

3. Gestão de Demandas e Melhoria Contínua


  • Receber, organizar e classificar demandas do negócio.
  • Conduzir análise de impacto funcional e sistêmico.
  • Priorizar backlog em conjunto com stakeholders.
  • Elaborar cronogramas e plano de ação.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento técnico-funcional.
  • Garantir documentação de processos e soluções.
  • Quando em projetos, garantir transição adequada para sustentação.

4. Análise Técnica, Estratégica e Gestão de Fornecedores, Consultorias e Governo


  • Entender e analisar requisitos e/ou necessidades do RH.
  • Atuar como interface com consultoria de suporte SuccessFactors.
  • Atuar como interface com consultoria de suporte Rimini Street para SAP HCM ECC e SAP Notes para SAP S/4Hana.
  • Abrir e acompanhar chamados junto à SAP e à Rimini Street.

title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About Signals:

  • Signals is YipitData’s Company Intelligence platform designed to help private equity firms, venture capital investors, finance, and corporate teams identify, diligence, and monitor software and technology companies using alternative data. Signals provides proprietary spend insights on 250K+ companies into a unified web platform, Chrome extension, and data feeds.
  • Customers use Signals to discover emerging companies, validate market trends, conduct diligence with deeper data (including invoice and product-level detail), and monitor portfolio performance using continuously refreshed alternative data


About The Role:

Our Signals product is quickly growing, and we are scaling our Data Product team to support new customer growth and product coverage expansion through our application, data feeds and AI agent experiences. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Product Analyst to join our Data Product team. This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Data Product Analysts and will own end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, translating product goals into clear plans, leading execution, and ensuring impact across analysis, data operations, and QA workflows.


As a Senior Data Product Analyst, Team Lead, you will:

  • Own strategy and end-to-end execution for a portfolio of high-impact data product initiatives, driving measurable product value through strong product and data judgment
  • Lead a team of 2+ Data Analysts who:
  • Deliver product-facing analyses and datasets, turning messy inputs (ERP financial data, web scraped data, invoices) into clean data insights
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and QA guidelines to measure and improve our AI and LLM powered workflows including defining quality targets, running experiments, and iterating based on results
  • Partner with Engineering to translate product needs into scalable workflows for our data products including defining business rules /requirements and improving QA / validation logic
  • Work primarily in Databricks, Google Sheets and with our proprietary AI agent tools, leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for speed, rigor, and innovation, balancing hands-on efforts yourself for the highest-impact work (complex analyses, ambiguous edge cases, AI evaluation design, and deep dive investigations) with coaching the team so execution scales beyond you
  • Own delivery planning and alignment, translate product goals into clear requirements and execution plans (scope, milestones, risks), apply strong product and data judgment to define what matters, and keep stakeholders aligned through consistent updates
  • Run delivery day to day, drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing requests, ensure timelines are met, and track/report progress, blockers, and next steps against your plan
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science,Engineering, and other key teams to identify leverage points, shape solutions, and drive adoption of improvements that increase product value and operational scalability
  • Have the opportunity to grow your career in the team with increasing levels of responsibility and diversified ownership areas


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or other technical function, including working with large datasets
  • You have 1+ years of experience leading others to deliver strong outcomes, through direct people management and/or team leadership (mentoring, coaching, setting direction, reviewing work, and driving accountability).
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of direct people management experience (including performance management)
  • You have experience working in a high-growth environment and managing many processes in parallel
  • You have experience owning end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives, applying strong product and data judgment to define success metrics, make pragmatic scope tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, including:
  • Scoping ambiguous problems
  • Building execution plans
  • Managing tradeoffs
  • Keeping stakeholders aligned through clear written and verbal updates
  • You are familiar working with large-scale datasets using Python and SQL (nice to have: PySpark, Databricks, and modern AI-assisted tools)
  • You have experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate data work including generating/refactoring SQL and Python, exploring datasets, drafting labeling guidelines, and validating outputs before applying them to real workflows
  • You are excited to identify and pilot AI driven initiatives, turning repetitive manual work into scalable processes through automation and better tooling while balancing risks and accuracy considerations of new AI systems
  • You have experience with data transformation techniques, maintenance of data pipelines, and quality assurance techniques
  • You are excited about the potential to train and raise the team’s ability to own projects, execute independently, and deliver consistently
  • You are available to work US Eastern time zone hours
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform.   • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Jr
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Mais.Mobi é uma empresa de mobilidade urbana com o propósito de repensar os setores de transporte e tecnologia para antecipar o futuro que as cidades e as pessoas desejam, a organização assume a gestão de diversos produtos e bilhetagens eletrônicas, como Riocard Mais e Cartão Macaé. Oferecemos soluções sob medida para o mercado, apoiando a atuação em atendimento, gestão, fidelização e meio de pagamento para transformar a mobilidade com segurança, transparência e suporte técnico.


Objetivo do Cargo: Procuramos um(a) Analista Júnior de Red Team / Pentest para integrar nossa equipe de Segurança Ofensiva, atuando nas avaliações técnicas de segurança, testes de intrusão e simulações de ataques avançados. Contribuirá para a identificação de vulnerabilidades, exploração controlada e desenvolvimento de melhorias contínuas nos controles de segurança dos ambientes corporativos.

A posição é ideal para quem já possui experiência inicial e domínio básico das principais ferramentas e metodologias de segurança ofensiva, além de interesse contínuo na evolução das técnicas de ataque e defesa cibernética.


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar testes de intrusão em aplicações web, APIs, redes internas e externas.
  • Conduzir avaliações de vulnerabilidades, análise de riscos técnicos e exploração controlada de falhas.
  • Apoiar e desenvolver atividades de simulação de ataques (Red Team Assessments) utilizando frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos e executivos, incluindo evidências, impactos e recomendações de mitigação.
  • Automatizar processos e desenvolver scripts para apoio às operações ofensivas.
  • Acompanhar tendências de ameaças, exploits, novas técnicas de ataque e atualizações em ferramentas de segurança.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Blue Team, SOC, Arquitetura e DevSecOps para validação e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de playbooks, metodologias e padrões internos de pentest e Red Team.


Necessário:

  • Formação completa em Segurança da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Pentest, Red Team, Ethical Hacking ou funções equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento prático das principais ferramentas: Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, SQLmap, Wireshark, OWASP ZAP.
  • Conhecimento em ambientes Windows e Linux, permissões, serviços e vetores de ataque comuns.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias: OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, PTES, NIST SP.
  • Noções de desenvolvimento seguro e pipelines DevSecOps (CI/CD, Git, integração de scanners automatizados).
  • Capacidade de documentação clara, objetiva e orientada a impacto.
  • Boa comunicação, pensamento analítico, capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e compromisso com a excelência.
  • Certificação CompTIA Security+.


Desejável:

  • Participação em CTFs, laboratórios práticos (HTB, TryHackMe, PortSwigger Academy).
  • Certificações como: eJPT, eCPPT, OSCP, PenTest+ e ISO/IEC 27001.
  • Conhecimentos de scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) ou automação ofensiva.
  • Inglês em nível intermediário.

It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Designer de Produto
description:
• Sobre a Payfy

A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia, e você precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.


  • O desafio

Você vai atuar junto de um time de ~20 de Produto (PM, devs, dados) para evoluir a experiência e o produto de ponta a ponta.

Essa não é uma posição para quem usa IA eventualmente. É para quem já incorporou IA no workflow e tem senso crítico para saber quando usar e quando não usar.


  • O que você vai fazer
  • Conduzir pesquisa com usuários (entrevistas, testes, descoberta contínua) e transformar insights em direção clara — usando IA para acelerar síntese e análise de feedback
  • Usar IA ativamente no workflow: geração de variações, rascunhos de stories, análise de dados qualitativos, automação de etapas repetitivas e muito mais
  • Conduzir iterações rápidas de protótipos (do rascunho ao validado) antes de buildar, com apoio de ferramentas de IA para ganhar velocidade sem perder qualidade
  • Manter sistema e consistência na experiência: design system, padrões, acessibilidade e handoff
  • Trabalhar com métricas e experimentação (funil, eventos, testes A/B) para orientar decisões com evidência



  • O que buscamos
  • Uso real de IA no dia a dia de design: Cria workflows, usa ferramentas como Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Galileo AI ou similares. Não é IA por moda — é IA com propósito.
  • Maturidade de discovery: Sabe definir problema, hipótese, método certo e chegar em decisão com evidência.
  • Qualidade de escrita: User stories claras, critérios de aceite objetivos e comunicação direta com o time.
  • Senso de produto e negócio (fintech): Entende trade-offs de conversão, retenção, risco e compliance.
  • Sistema e consistência: Experiência com design system, padrões e cuidado com edge cases.
  • Métricas e experimentação: Conforto em acompanhar impacto, instrumentação básica e aprendizado contínuo.



  • O que não buscamos
  • Quem usa IA apenas para gerar imagens bonitas, sem integrar ao processo de design e descoberta
  • Perfis focados só em execução visual, sem interesse em produto, dados e estratégia
  • Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção e ambientes com ritmo acelerado



  • O que oferecemos
  • 100% remoto | Contratação PJ
  • Remuneração: de R$20k – R$25k a combinar.
  • Autonomia real para evoluir o design do produto
  • Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível
  • Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e disseminar



Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.

Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação.
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs).
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.


Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .


Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.


Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.


Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.


Missão do cargo:


Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo:
  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;


Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.


Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

  • Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;

  • Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
  • Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
  • Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;

  • Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.


Gestão por dados

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
  • Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
  • Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
  • Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
  • Experiência com análise de dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
  • Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.

  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.


O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Mentalidade data-driven ;

title: Consultor(a) Comercial
description:
Junte-se à Robert Half e transforme carreiras e negócios.


Na Robert Half, estamos em constante evolução e buscamos Consultores(as) Comerciais com perfil consultivo, capazes de atuar em vendas complexas, de alto valor agregado , conectando desafios estratégicos de clientes às melhores soluções em talentos.


Quem somos e o que fazemos


Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos . Atuamos de forma próxima aos clientes, entendendo profundamente seus contextos de negócio, desafios e objetivos de longo prazo.

Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado.


O que oferecemos


  • Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo;
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido;
  • Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo;
  • Programas estruturados de treinamento em vendas consultivas e liderança;
  • Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para apoiar decisões comerciais;
  • Programas globais de reconhecimento e incentivo;
  • Oportunidades reais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.


Suas responsabilidades


Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:


  • Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, com foco em vendas complexas e consultivas ;
  • Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis;
  • Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos;
  • Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor;
  • Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente;
  • Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais;
  • Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.



Quem procuramos


Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:


  • Experiência prévia em vendas B2B complexas ou consultivas;
  • Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;
  • Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega;
  • Habilidade para construir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos;
  • Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório.
  • Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio;
  • Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;
  • Graduação completa;
  • Inglês avançado.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade


Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.


Faça parte da nossa história


Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

title: Careers & University Coordinator
description:
Careers & University Coordinator (Whole School)

Key responsibilities:

Strategic leadership and curriculum development

  • Curriculum Development: Develop and implement a progressive careers curriculum, integrating it with the school's IB programs and collaborating with Pastoral Leads and IB Coordinators to embed careers and life skills into the pastoral framework.
  • Training and Management: Lead the training and development of Year 12 and 13 Tutors and Heads of Year to provide consistent, high-quality university application support, ideally maintaining the same staff with each cohort for continuity.
  • Technology Integration: Manage and utilize an online central hub for all careers resources, communications, and student progress tracking.
  • Technology Integration: Ensure careers counselors have the tools and assessments needed to evaluate students' strengths and interests, guiding them toward suitable academic and career pathways.

Higher education guidance and admissions:

  • International admissions expertise : Provide expert guidance on domestic and international university applications, with strong knowledge of UCAS (UK), the Common Application (US), European systems, and the Brazilian Vestibular process, while maintaining close relationships with university admissions departments.
  • Specialized counseling: Provide targeted support for highly competitive applications, including Oxbridge-level counselling for the University of Oxford, the University of Cambridge, and Ivy League/top-tier US institutions.
  • Application management: Oversee all aspects of the application process, including setting and enforcing deadlines for student and teacher components, and ensuring transcript quality and accuracy.

Events, outreach, and student experience:

  • Parent presentations : Design and deliver parent presentations that clearly communicate admissions processes, funding options, and career pathways.
  • Alumni and local experts network : Support the development and maintenance of a strong alumni and local expert network to provide mentoring, career insights, and resources for current students.
  • School communication: Ensure timely and effective communication regarding all career
  • sevents, deadlines, and news across the whole school.
  • International Cultural Developmen t: Support the school leadership team in promoting global citizenship, international mindedness, and aspirations for international study.

Requirements

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential to effectively guide students and communicate with both local and international universities and parents.
  • Proven teaching experience at the secondary level, preferably within the IB framework.
  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, International Relations, HR or related fields, besides proven experience and demonstrable knowledge of the UCAS, US, European, and Brazilian university admissions processes.
  • Proven ability to build a comprehensive strategic vision in partnership with leadership colleagues to create buy-in from stakeholders and hold direct reports accountable for the day-to-today delivery of this vision.
  • Exceptional ability to build rapport with students, parents, university representatives, and colleagues. Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational, administrative, and project management skills.

title: Analista De Auditoria Interna I
description:
Descrição da vaga

SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Realizar auditorias internas de processos de negócios relacionados aos segmentos de comercialização, regulação e M&A, com ênfase na avaliação da eficiência dos processos, riscos e performance das operações, consistência e integridade das informações e na aderência à estratégia, às práticas estabelecidas, políticas e procedimentos internos e regulatórios.

Participar ativamente de reuniões com a gestão dos processos de negócios para compreender processos, identificar riscos e controles, coletar informações e validar evidências junto às áreas de negócios.

Apresentar resultados, comunicar observações e insights relevantes de forma clara e construtiva, colaborando na identificação das causas raiz e propondo recomendações e ações corretivas visando aprimoramento contínuo e geração de valor.

Aplicar técnicas quantitativas e de dados na execução dos trabalhos de auditoria, tais como:

- Tratamento, organização e análise de bases de dados aplicados aos processos de negócios avaliados;

- Desenvolver análises exploratórias de dados, identificação de padrões, anomalias, riscos ou exposições financeiras;

- Criar relatórios, planilhas e painéis de acompanhamento utilizando ferramentas como Excel avançado, Power BI ou similares.

- Apoiar a automação de análises recorrentes, quando aplicável, contribuindo para maior eficiência dos trabalhos de auditoria.

Elaborar reportes para a comunicação dos resultados do trabalho às áreas clientes (Relatórios de Auditoria) e reportes executivos para à Alta Administração (Consellho, Comitês e Diretoria Executiva).

Realizar o follow up dos planos de ações, para validação das implementações das ações de remediação e melhoria.

  • Base sólida em análise quantitativa e dados.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados aplicadas a processos e regras de negócios.
  • Graduação completa, preferencialmente em disciplinas de Ciências Exatas.
  • Inglês em nível intermediário.

Informações adicionais

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. - Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;

- Plano Médico e Odontológico;

title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America's, particularly Argentina's, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.

Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered .

Main Responsibilities

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Lower School Makerspace Teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).

The Lower School Makerspace Teacher is a dynamic and innovative educator who fosters creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving through hands-on STEM learning experiences. The ideal candidate is:

  • Holds a Bachelor's degree in Pedagogy and Arts, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics.
  • Has 3–5 years of qualified teaching experience, preferably in an international school context.
  • A skillful and creative practitioner in multilingual and interdisciplinary classrooms.
  • A motivated learner who takes responsibility for their own professional growth.
  • Someone who thrives in an environment of transformational leadership.
  • Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
  • Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.
  • And, most importantly, teaches students, not just subjects.

If you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference. Join a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive, and equitable, where everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging.

title: Hr Training Analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst

Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;

Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;

Interpret, apply,and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;

Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;

Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;

Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;

Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;

Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);

Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;

Proactive profilewith strong interface capability between HR and Operations.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances;

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);

Life Insurance;

Annual Bonus;

Private Pension Plan;

Childcare Allowance.

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.

In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Onboard Service Execution:

  • Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.
  • Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations.

Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution:

  • Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.
  • Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials.

Reports / Administrative Activities:

  • Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points.
  • Onboard service reports must be signed by customers.
  • Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner.

Participation in FAT Tests:

  • Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class.

Training:

  • Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
  • Participate in, observe, and comply with the company's health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
  • Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.
  • Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.

Who You Are:

You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.

For this role, you will need:

  • Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
  • 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments.
  • Availability to work overtime, as needed.
  • Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
  • Work location: Rio de Janeiro.

Our Culture and Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits;
life insurance;
credit union;
private pension plan;
recognition programs, and much more. Our people-focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software

Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.

Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.

Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.

Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.

Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.

Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes.
